critical_code_review_comments: routes/messages.py list_messages: when name='' and email='' both are provided (or omitted), the $in filter becomes empty and returns nothing. This is fine for the current UI (always queries by name/email), but documenting it: callers must pass at least one of name/email to see messages. Consider returning all stakeholder messages if both are empty, or short-circuiting the query. Non-blocking.

routes/snags.py SIG_PATH regex `^[MLml0-9 .,-]{4,30000}$` accepts any sequence of M/L/digits/space/dot/comma/dash — a trivial 'MMMM' string will pass validation even though it is not a drawn signature. The frontend's SignaturePad guarantees a real path but a public POST /api/s/{token}/sign could still accept 'MMMM'. Consider requiring at least one 'L' command (continuous stroke) or minimum coordinate count. Non-blocking.

routes/auth.py DELETE /api/auth/account deletes 15 collections in sequence; a partial failure between collections could leave orphan files. Current ordering (user doc last) is OK but consider wrapping in a transaction or background cleanup job as data grows.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test registers a disposable TEST_ user via /api/auth/register and deletes it via DELETE /api/auth/account. Frontend sign-off test added one TEST_Dave snag on demo and cleaned it + its snag_signoff afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — see /app/frontend/.env. Direct curl/requests to the preview host from inside the container is blocked by a 403 UA filter unless a browser-like User-Agent header is sent (python-requests default UA is allowed by pytest here, but urllib's default UA is blocked). For Playwright, run API calls via page.evaluate(fetch(...)) which proxies through the browser session. Signature-pad on web uses PanResponder + mouse drag; a programmatic mouse.down → multiple mouse.move → mouse.up over the signoff-pad bounding box produces a valid SVG path that enables signoff-confirm. Reserved email TLDs like .local/.test are rejected by Pydantic EmailStr; use @example.com for digest recipient tests.
